title: β-Branching in the biosynthesis of bongkrekic acid: a complex affair
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40855-40863
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05400A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Megan E. M. Hiseman, Annabel P. Phillips, Ciprian Chiriac, Liam J. Smith, John Crosby, Christopher Williams, Christine L. Willis, Ashley J. Winter, Matthew P. Crump
Bongkrekic acid biosynthesis requires a cassette of β-branching enzymes (BonF–BonI) to install two distinct β-branches. Here we confirm the roles of BonF–BonI in vitro and uncover a previously unannotated ACPD, BonN.
